page_title: UDI 0-0 BOL | Udinese v Bologna 28/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and the ball is aimed to the bottom right corner, but Lukasz Skorupski is alert and thwarts the effort.
90+2' Fabio Maresca interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Sam Beukema (Bologna). Udinese are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+1' A pass from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye and the move breaks down.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
89' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post.

87' Davide Calabria (Bologna) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
87' Substitution. Martin Payero makes his way off the pitch and Oier Zarraga (Udinese) comes on as his replacement.
87' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Arthur Atta will be replaced by Sandi Lovric (Udinese).

86' Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) attempts a header from outside the box after the free kick. It was too far from goal and failed to cause any serious trouble for Lukasz Skorupski, who made a comfortable save. The score remains the same.
85' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
83' Substitution. Nikola Moro (Bologna) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Remo Freuler walks off.
83' A substitution has been made. Thijs Dallinga is replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
81' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Christian Kabasele and he is replaced by Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese).
81' That's the end of the game for Keinan Davis, who is replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
80' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) controls the ball from the resulting free kick inside the six-yard box, but his effort is blocked by one of the defending players.
79' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) is penalised for holding. Fabio Maresca signals a set piece. Udinese will take a free kick.
77' Oumar Solet (Udinese) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
75' Sam Beukema (Bologna) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
75' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
75' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. Bologna will take a corner kick.

74' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bologna.
74' The resulting corner from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is cleared by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
73' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The referee points to the corner flag and Bologna will take a corner.
70' Yellow card. Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
70' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Bologna.
67' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His rocket of a shot crashes against the crossbar! What a shot.
66' Martin Payero (Udinese) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

66' Martin Payero (Udinese) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Bologna win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
65' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) is brought on as a substitute for Benjamin Dominguez.
62' Here is a change. Jens Odgaard is going off and Daniel Niccolini gives the last tactical orders to Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
61' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
60' The corner from Juan Miranda (Bologna) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye.
59' The resulting corner from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
59' A cross from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Bologna get a corner.
55' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
55' Rui Modesto (Udinese) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
52' Martin Payero (Udinese) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
50' Sam Beukema (Bologna) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
49' Martin Payero (Udinese) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
49' The resulting corner, taken by Martin Payero (Udinese), comes to nothing. Corner kick. Udinese will have an opportunity.
48' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Now Udinese have a corner.
47' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) comes onto the pitch so that Michel Aebischer can be given a rest.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' None of the Udinese players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' Keinan Davis (Udinese) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' That's unlucky! Keinan Davis (Udinese) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
41' Oumar Solet (Udinese) sends a long ball in, but Lukasz Skorupski comfortably gathers the ball.

38' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Arthur Atta (Udinese) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
36' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp is being substituted because of an injury. Kosta Runjaic sends Rui Modesto (Udinese) on the pitch.
34' The game is interrupted now, Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' A neat pass is well received by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
33' Davide Calabria (Bologna) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
30' The free kick into the box finds Keinan Davis (Udinese), who heads the ball towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping skills.
29' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
28' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maduka Okoye intercepts the ball.
26' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) commits a foul and Fabio Maresca immediately signals a free kick.
23' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

22' Martin Payero (Udinese) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the right side of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski made a superb athletic save to deny him. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
20' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is caught offside!
19' Great touch by Martin Payero (Udinese) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
18' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Fabio Maresca stops the game and makes a call. Bologna are awarded a free kick.

14' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
10' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and it's Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

9' The corner is swung in and Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
9' The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.
7' Keinan Davis (Udinese) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
4' Juan Miranda (Bologna) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
3' Crossbar! Keinan Davis (Udinese) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
2' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul after Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) hacks down one of his opponents. Bologna get a free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Udinese will kick-off.
Fabio Maresca will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
